events.title: Oasis' Definitely Maybe turns 32
events.blurb: Oasis released their iconic debut album 'Definitely Maybe' on August 29, 1994.

angles.name: Debut Album Anniversary
angles.copy: Thirty-two years ago, Oasis dropped 'Definitely Maybe' and changed the sound of British music forever. Still sounding absolutely biblical.

events.title: Woodstock Festival's 57th Anniversary
events.blurb: The legendary Woodstock Music & Art Fair began on this day in 1969 in Bethel, New York.

angles.name: Peace & Music
angles.copy: Fifty-seven years since half a million people descended on a dairy farm for three days of peace, love, and music. Happy Woodstock anniversary!

events.title: Remembering Elvis Presley
events.blurb: Elvis Presley passed away on this day in 1977.

angles.name: King of Rock 'n' Roll
angles.copy: Remembering the King of Rock 'n' Roll, Elvis Presley, who left us on this day in 1977 but whose music lives on.

events.title: Remembering Jimi Hendrix
events.blurb: Legendary guitarist Jimi Hendrix passed away on September 18, 1970, at the age of 27.

angles.name: Guitar Icon Tribute
angles.copy: A true guitar visionary, Jimi Hendrix, whose incredible talent was silenced far too soon on this day in 1970. His sound continues to inspire.

events.title: The Beatles' Abbey Road turns 57
events.blurb: The Beatles released their iconic 'Abbey Road' album on September 26, 1969, in the UK, and October 1, 1969, in the US.

angles.name: Iconic Album Cover
angles.copy: The one with *that* zebra crossing! The Beatles' 'Abbey Road' album turns 57 today, still one of the most recognisable covers in music history.

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: The Pretenders frontwoman Chrissie Hynde celebrates her 75th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock Trailblazer
angles.copy: Happy 75th birthday to the legendary Chrissie Hynde! A true rock trailblazer and powerhouse voice with The Pretenders.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Former Oasis frontman Liam Gallagher celebrates his 54th birthday today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star Birthday
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher – still bringing the swagger. As you were.

events.title: John Lennon's 'Imagine' turns 55
events.blurb: John Lennon released his iconic 'Imagine' album on September 9, 1971, in the US, and October 8, 1971, in the UK. The single was released on October 11, 1971, in the US.

angles.name: Timeless Peace Anthem
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine' a better world. A timeless message that resonates just as powerfully today.

events.title: The first iPod turns 25
events.blurb: Apple unveiled the very first iPod on this day in 2001, revolutionising portable music.

angles.name: Tech Game Changer
angles.copy: Remember life before this? The original iPod launched 25 years ago today, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: Happy James Bond Day!
events.blurb: James Bond Day marks the anniversary of the world premiere of 'Dr. No' in London on October 5, 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: Grab a martini, shaken not stirred! It's James Bond Day, celebrating over six decades of 007 on the big screen.

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: We remember John Lennon, who would have celebrated his 86th birthday today.

angles.name: Lennon's Legacy
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the enduring legacy of John Lennon – a true musical icon and advocate for peace.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Legendary comedian and actor John Cleese celebrates his 87th birthday today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend Birthday
angles.copy: Happy 87th birthday to the utterly brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true master of British comedy.

events.title: The Beatles' 'White Album' turns 58
events.blurb: The Beatles released their self-titled double album, commonly known as the 'White Album', on November 22, 1968.

angles.name: Landmark Double Album
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago, The Beatles unleashed the 'White Album'. A sprawling, eclectic masterpiece that still sparks debate and delight.
